title: Python Modules and Packages – An Introduction
description: Explore Python modules and packages, the two mechanisms that make modular programming possible, and learn how imports find your code.
summary: This article explores Python modules and Python packages , two mechanisms that facilitate modular programming . Modular programming refers to the process of breaking a large, unwieldy programming task into separate, smaller, more manageable subtasks or modules .
